WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT id
                FROM work_items
                WHERE status = $1
                ORDER BY expiry, id
                FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            claimed AS (
                UPDATE work_items wi
                SET status = $2
                FROM candidate c
                WHERE wi.id = c.id
                RETURNING wi.flow_id, wi.kind
            )
            SELECT c.flow_id, c.kind, f.ordinal, f.seed
            FROM claimed c
            INNER JOIN flows f ON f.id = c.flow_id
